info.title: KonfigMap
info.description: KonfigMap is a .NET global tool that generates Kubernetes ConfigMap-compatible properties files from ASP.NET Core JSON configuration files.

x-inspectra.cliParsedDescription: konfigmap v2 - Generate Kubernetes ConfigMap-compatible .properties files from ASP.NET Core JSON configuration.

options.name: --input-file
options.description: One or more JSON configuration file paths to process.

options.name: --input-dir
options.description: One or more directories to scan recursively for JSON configuration files.

options.name: --output-dir
options.description: Output directory for the generated file. [default: .]

options.name: --separator
options.description: Character(s) to replace ':' in hierarchical keys. ASP.NET Core uses '__' for env vars. [default: __]

options.name: --exclude
options.description: Regex pattern — keys matching this are excluded from output. [default: ]

options.name: --include
options.description: Regex pattern — only keys matching this are included in output. [default: ]

options.name: --tokenize
options.description: Replace values with tokenized placeholders for CI/CD variable substitution. [default: False]

options.name: --leaf-only
options.description: Emit only leaf (terminal) values, skipping parent/section keys. [default: True]

options.name: --dry-run
options.description: Print output to stdout without writing a file. [default: False]

options.name: --verbose
options.description: Enable verbose (debug-level) logging for detailed traceability. [default: False]
